title: ITVX / Many typographic voices
slide_intent: Use type contrast to express a range of programme and audience voices, because letterforms shape the tone and reading emphasis of a message.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen a recognizable voice across different programme moods.
demonstration: A yellow printed sheet mixes italic sans, serif, bold sans and fine sans phrases at different scales, including STREAMING NOW and Nice to meet you.
practical_value: Use type contrast to express a range of programme and audience voices.
